messages:
Anna K: Quick follow-up from the postmortem earlier — I put together a compact triage cookbook and action list for the 503/latency surge. Need owners + realistic ETAs by EOD.

Ben M: I can take the KV cache eviction investigation. ETA: 2026-04-02.

Carlos R: I'll own the autoscaler tuning + a focused load repro job. Plan: run canary load Wed and post results.

Lucy W: I'll update playbook escalation steps. Proposing: page infra-sre on thrash >=3x in 10m.

Tina (oncall): Clarify: do we embed minimal triage commands in the page so oncall can act fast? I'm +1 for inline commands.

sre-bot: Created tasks: TASK-3412 (KV eviction), TASK-3413 (autoscaler), TASK-3414 (playbook edit).

Anna K: Proposed minimal triage block to embed in playbook (and include in page body):

```
# minimal triage (infra-tools)
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep model
kubectl -n inference logs <pod> -c inference --tail=200 | grep "evict" || true
curl -s "http://metrics:9090/api/v1/query?query=rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])" | jq .
# if thrash: /sherlock page infra-sre "Latency thrash >3x baseline — tagging TASK-3412"
```

Anna K: Action summary (draft):
- TASK-3412: KV eviction analysis — owner Ben M — ETA 2026-04-02
- TASK-3413: Autoscaler tuning & repro — owner Carlos R — ETA 2026-03-31
- TASK-3414: Playbook + escalation edits — owner Lucy W — ETA 2026-03-29
- TASK-3415: Recurrence watch (2w) — owner Tina (oncall) — start 2026-03-30 (weekly checks)

Ben M: Adding checklist: correlate eviction events with model-compile/quantization jobs and attach example log markers.

Carlos R: For TASK-3413 I'll add an e2e-load namespace job and post the load script to the task.

Lucy W: Will add the triage block above to the playbook and a short escalation matrix:
- Page infra-sre for thrash
- If infra-sre unacked >10m, page eng-leads + runbook-runner on-call

Tina (oncall): I'll subscribe to TASK-3412/3413 and run the first recurrence check next Tue. Please add a symptom blurb to tasks: "latency + 5xx ratio increase + evictions".

Anna K: Done: symptom blurb added to TASK-3412. Two asks: Ben, attach grep patterns/log snippets. Lucy, mark playbook edit as high-priority so it lands before the next on-call rotation.

sre-bot: TASK-3412 assigned to Ben M, due=2026-04-02. TASK-3414 assigned to Lucy W, due=2026-03-29, priority=high.

Ben M: Confirmed, will attach logs and grep examples.

Lucy W: Confirmed, will open a docs PR and ping @docs-reviewers.

Anna K: Let's do a 20m sync Mon 09:30 to validate progress and adjust ETAs. If anything slips, update the TASK and post in this thread. Thanks :thumbsup:
